data.name: Pradyuman
data.gender_notes: Pradyuman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pradyuman is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pradat' which means 'gift'. The name Pradyuman signifies the gift of a child to the parents, symbolizing the joy and happiness that a child brings to a family. It also represents intelligence, courage, and the nurturing qualities of the parents. The name Pradyuman carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pradyuman usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pradyuman is a name that signifies the divine gift of life and the blessings of the gods. It is believed that a child named Pradyuman will be blessed with intelligence, courage, and the ability to nurture and care for others.
data.etymology: Pradyuman belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pradyuman total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

The naming ritual is an essential part of Indian culture, and the name Pradyuman signifies the arrival of a new life into the world, which is celebrated with great joy and enthusiasm.

historical_references.reference: Pradyuman was a famous Jain Tirthankara who lived around 810 BCE in the Arjikumarasana region. He is also known as Prasenajit, the son of King Chedi.
historical_references.context: Jain Tirthankara and ruler of the Chedi Kingdom in ancient India.

historical_references.reference: Pradyuman is also the name of a legendary king of Magadha, who is believed to have ruled in the 5th century BCE. He is known for his wisdom and is often depicted as a just and powerful king.
historical_references.context: Legendary king of Magadha in ancient India.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Pradyuman' is of Hindu origin, meaning 'pure man'. In modern times, this name is most commonly associated with Pradyuman Thakur, an Indian boy who was tragically murdered in a private school in Gurgaon, India, in 2017. His death sparked widespread outrage and calls for improved school safety and security. Another Pradyuman, Pradyuman Iyengar, is a renowned yoga instructor and author based in Mumbai, India. His books and YouTube channel provide guidance on various aspects of yoga and mindfulness practices. Lastly, Pradyuman Jha is a prominent Indian entrepreneur and businessman, known for his work in the e-commerce sector. He frequently shares insights and trends on LinkedIn.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Lakshmi Pradyuman in Delhi, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Pradyuman, which means "Gift of God". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
